Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix BUG_06_00_001: Events lost when downloading PDFs on iOS Safari

Root cause: iOS Safari fires pagehide when opening PDFs in new tabs,
setting unloadHandled=true. When page restores from BFCache, the flag
stays true, blocking all subsequent event flushes.

Fix: Add pageshow listener to reset unloadHandled when page is restored
from BFCache \(event.persisted === true\).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
